accuracy_vs_naive.name: accuracy vs repeating the same weekday last week
accuracy_vs_naive.reason_plain: This model is 24.2% more accurate than simply repeating what happened on the same weekday last week, so it is the better of the two estimates.

signal.name: signal (shuffled-target control)
signal.threshold_source: calibrated against a measured null distribution (n=360, false-positive rate 0.00%); see reports/sentinel_calibration.md
signal.reason_plain: Shuffling the historical answers made this model's error 1.23 times worse (we require 1.15 times). The inputs carry real information about what happens next.
signal.corroboration: Confirmed with two further instruments (a decision tree and a random forest) in reports/sentinel_probe_study.md; all three agree.

leakage.name: leakage
leakage.reason_plain: No feature was found to carry information from after the forecast origin.

persistence_mimicry.name: persistence-mimicry (shift diagnostic)
persistence_mimicry.threshold: predictions must not be a lagged copy
persistence_mimicry.reason_plain: The forecast does not simply replay a recent actual.

coverage.name: interval coverage
coverage.reason_plain: This model reports no prediction intervals, so their calibration was not measured. Point forecasts are unaffected.

overfitting.name: overfitting cap
overfitting.reason_plain: The model is not much better on data it trained on than on data it did not, so it has not memorised the history.
